fails_if: the register loader refuses a `[[coding.documented]]` own-source certificate (finite periods, exact rows, non-empty `raw_codings`, no enumeration or PDF), or drops its raw coding fingerprints
note: The allowed twin of the two mixed-authority refusals beside it: the same file without `document_url` or `enumeration`. The replaced test built this entry as its base before adding the mixed authority; the raw fingerprint is read from the TOML.
